records.scope: Entire untruncated javap display of LegendPanel and LegendTable, including layout, dispatch, headers and column sizing.
records.observation: JTable constructs LegendTableModel(categoryMap), sets model, CategoryIcon default renderer/editor; autoResize0, cell spacing2x2, horizontal lines false/vertical true. Saves column model/header then initializes headers and sizes. Each nonzero column gets GenericHeaderRenderer, initPressablePullDownTab; menu by index1 OperationStringMenu,2/3 OperationBooleanMenu,4/5/6 OperationNumberMenu,other null. Attaches separate TableHeaderHandler to header and TableColumnHandler to table for each nonzero column, all receive same popup for that column. Column0 gets no handlers/tab here; if existing renderer null creates GenericHeaderRenderer; tooltip assignment only in nonnull branch, cast to JComponent unchecked. No sorter implemented here; actual popup/handlers/model semantics pending. initColumnSize renders each header at row-1 and model maximum sample at row0 to derive preferred dimensions, uses model.getColumnClass default renderer when cell renderer absent. Header width adds intercell width plus horizontal insets to renderer preferred width; cell sample width adds insets only for CategoryIconRenderer (otherwise zero); preferred column width max(header,cell). Viewport width sums ONLY columns indices<4, remaining numeric columns scroll. Row height=max sample preferred height plus icon renderer vertical insets, not header height, no added intercell height; viewport height=rowheight*min(rowcount,25). No own bounds/overflow guard; depends on valid sample objects/renderers/JComponent casts; sampling is not full data width scan. No model change listener recomputes sizes here. Static EMPTY_INSETS allzero. No selectAll/clearSelection override or direct Parameters/TopControl assignment. Thus panel Select/Deselect remain table selection commands, and Control is not initialized in panel/table direct code; deeper model/renderer constructors still separate evidence. No archived GUI execution.
